pageDesc: Connect the Zhiyuan extension to reuse your browser sign-in, capture trending posts, and save materials locally for remixing.
collectFailed: Capture failed. Check that the extension is enabled and the URL is supported.
connectOpenedFallback: Sign-in page opened. Refresh after you finish signing in.
installHeroTitle: Install the extension to find hits
installHeroSubtitle: Follow the tutorial on the right, then capture from Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and Bilibili.
productReleaseNote: 3.7.7: workbench-triggered Xiaohongshu keyword searches use a temporary foreground tab, follow the configured capture interval, run serially, and close the temporary tab when returning to the workbench.
browserSupport: Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and QQ Browser
detectWaitHint: After installing or reloading the extension, wait a moment for auto-detect; refresh this page only if it still does not connect.
updateRequiredHint: Account status still works; update the extension before keyword capture.
updateRequiredBody: Detected extension v{{current}}; this workbench needs v{{required}}+. Download the new package, remove the old extension in chrome://extensions, then reload. The new build injects into open workbench tabs automatically.
captureBlockedOutdated: Extension v{{current}} is too old. Update to v{{required}} before capturing.
sandboxNote: Runs in the browser sandbox; cookies stay on this device
step01BodyBefore: Click the puzzle icon in the toolbar and choose Manage extensions, or type
step02Body: Enable Developer mode in the top-right corner. Buttons for loading local extensions will appear.
step03BodyAfter: file onto the center of the extensions page and release to install.
fallbackTitle: If the browser cannot load the ZIP or does not respond:
fallbackStep1: Unzip the downloaded ZIP into a folder.
fallbackStep2: On the extensions page, click Load unpacked.
fallbackStep3: Select that folder and confirm to finish installation.
afterInstallBody: Refresh the workbench to reuse browser sign-in and capture posts.
connectionPanelDesc: Connect the Zhiyuan extension in this browser. Sign-in and capture stay on your device and are not uploaded to our servers.
connectedHint: Bridge is ready; you can resolve post URLs anytime.
disconnectedHint: Load Zhiyuan in Chrome/Edge and enable developer mode.
cookiePrivacy: Platform sign-in is stored locally in your browser. Parsed content is saved on this device only—it never goes through our servers.
quickCaptureDesc: Single-post links from Douyin, Xiaohongshu, or Bilibili; title and body are extracted automatically.
urlPlaceholder: Paste a share link, e.g. https://v.douyin.com/... or https://www.xiaohongshu.com/...
libraryDesc: Captured materials stay only in this browser—not in the cloud—so your account and content stay safer. Pick them up from any creation page.
libraryEmpty: No local materials yet. Capture a link above or paste a link on a creation page.
illusChromiumBrowsers: Chromium browsers: Chrome, Edge, 360, QQ, etc.
materialPersistImagesLabel: Save images locally when capturing (uses disk space)
materialPersistImagesHint: By default only URLs are stored; re-capture if links expire. When enabled, blurred thumbnails are saved as a local fallback.
materialClearFallbacksConfirm: Clear local image fallbacks for all materials? URLs and text will be kept.
materialClearAllConfirm: Clear the entire local library? This cannot be undone.
materialVideoUnavailable: Video URL unavailable. Sign in on the platform and re-capture, or open the original post.
materialLinkExpired: Link expired. Sign in on the platform and capture again.
captureNotConnectedError: Extension not connected. Please confirm Zhiyuan is running in 'Install & Status'.
captureNotFoundKeyword: No trending posts found for keyword "{{keyword}}". Please try another keyword.
captureFailedGeneric: Keyword capture failed. Please check extension status.
captureSuccessKeywordBatch: Capture completed: successfully saved {{count}} trending posts.
captureAllUrlsFailed: None of the URLs could be resolved. Please check link format or confirm you are signed in.
searchKeywordPlaceholder: Enter keyword to capture, press Enter or click right to start...
captureTip: 💡 Tip: Make sure your browser is signed in to the target platform before capturing.
linksModeDesc: Supports Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and Bilibili post links. One link per line for batch resolution.
linksInputPlaceholder:
Paste post URLs (one per line), e.g.:
https://www.xiaohongshu.com/explore/64f123...
https://v.douyin.com/idK1234/
https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1xx411...
linksPrivacyNote: Resolution runs locally. Cookies and data stay on your device.
batchResultSuccessDesc: Materials are safely saved in local library and tagged with this task.
materialEmptyDescNew: Please enter URLs or search by keywords on the 'Capture' tab. Captured items will be saved here.
materialEmptyDescFiltered: No materials match the current filters. Try clearing your filters or search query.
